name: 锁诊断通用 — 各类锁争用的综合诊断
description: Oracle 锁争用综合诊断规则。覆盖 TX（行锁/事务锁）、TM（表锁）、UL（用户锁）等各类 enqueue 争用的统一排查方法。包含 blocker 状态深度分析（空闲/慢SQL/被阻塞）、多层阻塞链追溯、死锁检测和影响评估。

root_causes.name: 长事务持锁不释放
root_causes.desc: 事务执行 DML 后长时间未 COMMIT/ROLLBACK，持有行锁阻塞其他会话。常见于忘记提交的交互式会话。

root_causes.name: 热点行争用
root_causes.desc: 多个事务同时更新同一行（如余额扣减、计数器递增），TX 行锁争用。需应用层优化。

root_causes.name: 锁升级或锁范围过大
root_causes.desc: UPDATE 缺少索引导致全表扫描锁定过多行，或应用使用了 LOCK TABLE。

root_causes.name: 分布式事务锁
root_causes.desc: 通过 DB Link 的分布式事务中，远端锁持有时间长。2PC 准备阶段的锁可能长时间不释放。

root_causes.name: ITL 争用
root_causes.desc: 数据块的 ITL 槽位不足，新事务无法在块上记录锁信息，等待 ITL 释放。表现为 enq: TX - allocate ITL entry。

root_causes.name: 未提交事务持锁（blocker 空闲）
root_causes.desc: Blocker 完成 DML 后未提交，处于空闲/应用等待状态。不会自行释放锁，需外部干预。

root_causes.name: 慢 SQL 持锁
root_causes.desc: Blocker 正在执行耗时 SQL，完成前不会释放锁。需优化 blocker 的 SQL。

root_causes.name: 死锁（循环等待）
root_causes.desc: 多个事务形成循环锁依赖。Oracle 自动检测（ORA-00060），但频繁死锁说明应用设计有问题。

root_causes.name: DDL/DML 冲突
root_causes.desc: DDL 操作（ALTER TABLE 等）与活跃 DML 冲突，互相阻塞。

step1_victim_impact.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) victim_count, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session WHERE type='USER' AND status='ACTIVE'),0),1) blocked_pct FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL

step2_blocker_state.desc: 分析 blocker 的状态和等待事件
step2_blocker_state.sql: SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.status, s.event AS blocker_event, s.sql_id, s.last_call_et idle_sec, CASE WHEN s.event IN ('PL/SQL lock timer','SQL*Net message from client','Streams AQ: waiting for messages in the queue','pipe get','jobq slave wait','smon timer','pmon timer') OR s.status = 'INACTIVE' THEN 'IDLE_PATTERN' WHEN s.event LIKE 'enq:%' AND s.blocking_session IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALSO_BLOCKED' ELSE 'WORKING' END AS blocker_activity, s.blocking_session AS blocker_of_blocker FROM v$session s WHERE s.sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL)

step3_deadlock_check.desc: 检查死锁统计和循环阻塞
step3_deadlock_check.sql: SELECT (SELECT value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name = 'enqueue deadlocks') deadlock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session a, v$session b WHERE a.blocking_session = b.sid AND b.blocking_session = a.sid AND a.sid < b.sid) circular_blocks FROM dual

step4_chain_depth.sql: SELECT MAX(lvl) max_depth FROM (SELECT LEVEL lvl FROM v$session START WITH sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) CONNECT BY PRIOR blocking_session = sid AND LEVEL <= 10)

step5_blocker_sql.sql: SELECT s.sid, s.sql_id, SUBSTR(q.sql_text,1,200) sql_text, q.elapsed_time/GREATEST(q.executions,1)/1e6 avg_sec FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$sql q ON s.sql_id = q.sql_id AND q.child_number = 0 WHERE s.sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) AND s.sql_id IS NOT NULL

step6_lock_tree.sql: SELECT LPAD(' ',2*(level-1)) || sid sid_tree, serial#, username, event, blocking_session, sql_id, seconds_in_wait, status FROM v$session START WITH blocking_session IS NULL AND sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) CONNECT BY PRIOR sid = blocking_session ORDER SIBLINGS BY seconds_in_wait DESC

step7_enqueue_detail.sql: SELECT l.sid, l.type, DECODE(l.type,'TX','Row Lock','TM','Table Lock','UL','User Lock',l.type) lock_type, DECODE(l.lmode,0,'-',1,'N',2,'RS',3,'RX',4,'S',5,'SRX',6,'X') hold_mode, DECODE(l.request,0,'-',1,'N',2,'RS',3,'RX',4,'S',5,'SRX',6,'X') req_mode FROM v$lock l WHERE (l.lmode > 0 OR l.request > 0) AND l.sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT sid FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY l.type, l.lmode DESC

step8_ddl_check.desc: 检查是否有 DDL 操作参与锁争用
step8_ddl_check.sql: SELECT s.sid, s.sql_id, SUBSTR(q.sql_text,1,100) sql_text FROM v$session s JOIN v$sql q ON s.sql_id = q.sql_id AND q.child_number = 0 WHERE s.sid IN (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT sid FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) AND (UPPER(q.sql_text) LIKE 'ALTER%' OR UPPER(q.sql_text) LIKE 'DROP%' OR UPPER(q.sql_text) LIKE 'CREATE%' OR UPPER(q.sql_text) LIKE 'TRUNCATE%')

修复应用在 DML 后及时 COMMIT
设置 IDLE_TIME 资源限制

then.step: Step 3: 检查 DDL 参与

branches.label: DDL 操作参与锁争用
findings: DDL 操作（ALTER/CREATE/DROP）与活跃 DML 冲突
DDL 需要获取排他锁，与 DML 的行锁不兼容

actions.desc: 在维护窗口执行 DDL，避免业务高峰
使用 ONLINE DDL（如 ALTER TABLE ... ONLINE）减少锁冲突
设置 DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT 避免无限等待
